evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission purpose, users and rationale with references. However, goals lack quantitative requirements (resolution, revisit, latency) and contain exaggerated bleaching statistics, limiting completeness.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart. Detailed task descriptions can be found on the next page.

criteria.reasoning: Detailed Gantt chart and task descriptions demonstrate feasibility. Missing explicit contingency provisions and a dedicated list of planned information sources, so not fully Accomplished.

evidence.quote: My current choice is a geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km

criteria.reasoning: Minor work completed: STK tutorials 1–4 and background research. No actual technical results or simulations presented; orbit choice is stated but technically incorrect.

evidence.quote: Coral reefs harbour some of the most diverse species of life on the planet

criteria.reasoning: Well-structured and readable with clear headings and labelled Gantt chart. References are URL-only, not properly formatted citations, and some informal phrasing reduces professionalism.

technical_issues.where: Project Plan & Preliminary Progress — Orbit Specifics
technical_issues.issue: States geostationary orbit at 600 km altitude; GEO is ~35,786 km, 600 km is LEO and cannot remain fixed over the reef.
Claims 2016 bleaching killed 60% and 2017 another 50% of GBR coral; actual mortality estimates are substantially lower (~20–30% per event).
'Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic' is imprecise; pH has dropped ~0.1, representing ~30% increase in hydrogen ion concentration.
No quantitative mission requirements (spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency) are specified.
Gantt chart shows background research as both completed (gold) and ongoing (blue) in overlapping weeks; editing scheduled weeks 9–10 but text says weeks 7–8 reserved for review.

overall: A clear, well-structured preliminary report with a strong mission rationale and detailed Gantt plan. However, it contains a major orbit error (GEO at 600 km), exaggerated bleaching statistics, lacks quantitative mission requirements, contingency planning, and a proper reference list. Preliminary technical results are minimal.
